titulo: Quiz — The first round starts before the tacos
subtitulo: Place the group, discover the channel and buy menu time
introPt: Two travellers enter a busy taquería. Listen for the moment when the service format becomes clear and for the phrase that leaves the food order open.
cenario: A pair gets a table, discovers that this location takes orders at the cashier and orders sparkling water while reading the menu.

dialogo.es: Buenas tardes. Somos dos. ¿Hay mesa para dos?
dialogo.pt: Good afternoon. There are two of us. Is there a table for two?

dialogo.es: ¿Nos sentamos aquí? ¿Ordeno aquí o en la mesa?
dialogo.pt: Do we sit here? Do I order here or at the table?

dialogo.es: Sí, adelante. Aquí en la caja, por favor.
dialogo.pt: Yes, go ahead. Here at the cashier, please.

dialogo.es: Un agua mineral, por favor. Eso es todo por ahora, gracias.
dialogo.pt: One sparkling water, please. That is all for now, thank you.

perguntas.pergunta: What does Somos dos solve first?
perguntas.explica: It makes the arriving group visible before the table request.

perguntas.pergunta: Why ask ¿Ordeno aquí o en la mesa?
perguntas.explica: The question works across counter, cashier and table-service formats.

perguntas.pergunta: In this scene, where does the order begin?
perguntas.explica: Aquí en la caja identifies the local channel in this scene.

perguntas.pergunta: What does Un agua mineral buy besides the drink?
opcoes: Time to read the food menu
perguntas.explica: The first beverage lets the visit begin before the food decision is ready.

perguntas.pergunta: Why add por ahora to Eso es todo?
perguntas.explica: Por ahora means for now, leaving the food order open.
